data.action: 趴在房车大床上，双手托着下巴，长长的兔耳在头顶前后轻摇，毛茸茸的白尾巴在背后翘起，狡黠地冲着博士眨眼。

data.description: 雷姆必拓改装野营房车后舱，圆形舷窗外是荒野落日染红的漫天风沙。趴在房车大床上，双手托着下巴，长长的兔耳在头顶前后轻摇，毛茸茸的白尾巴在背后翘起，狡黠地冲着博士眨眼。 她微微抬眸轻语——“野外生存指南第三条：在舒适的被窝里，猎人和猎物的身份随时都有可能互换哦，博士~！”
data.promptProse: Ray lies on her stomach across the wide bed inside a modified Rim Billiton camper van at dusk, wearing an apricot-peach crinkled linen open-back camisole with white pom-pom ties and flutter-hem sleep shorts. Propping her chin in both hands with a sly wink, she glows in rich amber desert sunset pouring through the circular porthole.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her stomach across the camper bed with her chin cupped in both hands in a peach open-back ruffled linen camisole and shorts, she shoots a playful wink at the viewer. Warm desert sunset light pours through the round porthole over the rough-woven blankets.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an apricot-peach crinkled linen open-back ruffled camisole tied with tiny white pom-pom cords and matching flutter-hem sleep shorts.
